page.notes: The first line of the page is cut off at the top ("operi" begins the page-text after the running head). The word "abacta" at line end and "stam" are set with a long-s-like initial; the initial of "stam" appears as a decorated A-form and is read as "ctam"/"abactam". Catchword "nu-" at the end is the line-end hyphen of "monumentum"; it is part of the text, not a catchword.
